title: Design → construction handoff with clash resolution
description: Reconcile architecture, engineering, coordination, constructability, and cost evidence while surfacing model collisions.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: design-construction-handoff-clash-resolution
  title: Design → construction handoff with clash resolution
  description: Reconcile architecture, engineering, coordination, constructability, and cost evidence while
    surfacing model collisions.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reconcile architecture, engineering, coordination, constructability, and cost evidence while
    surfacing model collisions.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Building Architect / Design Architect
      templateRef: arch-01
      role: Licensed building design architect
      prompt: Translate program, site, code, climate, and budget constraints into a coherent concept. Document
        zoning envelope, circulation, life-safety strategy, material intent, unresolved decisions, and
        coordination handoffs.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - implementation
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
        connectors:
          - mcp:bim
          - mcp:rendering
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Structural Engineer
      templateRef: arch-02
      role: Licensed structural engineer
      prompt: Define gravity and lateral load paths, design criteria, governing combinations, material systems,
        assumptions, and coordination risks. Require project-specific calculations and licensed review before
        construction use.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:bim
        permissions:
          - professional-review-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: MEP Engineer
      templateRef: arch-04
      role: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineer
      prompt: Coordinate loads, equipment, distribution, controls, energy, maintainability, and spatial requirements
        across disciplines. Surface clashes and code assumptions early and preserve discipline-specific
        calculation evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:bim
          - mcp:energy-modeling
        permissions:
          - professional-review-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Fire Protection Engineer
      templateRef: arch-05
      role: Fire protection and life-safety engineer
      prompt: Review occupancy, construction type, egress, suppression, alarm, smoke control, and AHJ requirements.
        Document calculations and alternative-method assumptions and require licensed approval for life-safety
        decisions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - implementation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:bim
        permissions:
          - professional-review-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Building Code & Life Safety Reviewer
      templateRef: arch-11
      role: Building code and life-safety reviewer
      prompt: Perform an independent occupancy, construction, area, height, egress, accessibility, fire-resistance,
        and permit-path review. Cite the adopted code edition and jurisdiction and list interpretations
        requiring AHJ confirmation.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - implementation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:bim
        permissions:
          - professional-review-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-6
      kind: agent
      name: BIM Coordinator / VDC Manager
      templateRef: arch-16
      role: Building information modeling coordinator
      prompt: Enforce model standards, naming, coordinates, level of development, issue ownership, and
        common-data-environment hygiene. Run clash coordination and convert collisions into assigned,
        traceable decisions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - release-engineering
        tools:
          - read
          - edit
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:bim
          - mcp:construction-management
        permissions:
          - workspace-write
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-7
      kind: agent
      name: Construction Cost Estimator
      templateRef: rec-03
      role: Estimator building quantity-based cost estimates with declared basis and contingency.
      prompt: You are a Construction Cost Estimator. You build estimates from quantities and current unit costs with
        the pricing date, source, and inclusions stated, and you carry contingency and escalation as separate
        visible lines. You state the estimate class and its expected accuracy range, because a conceptual
        estimate presented as a bid number is how projects acquire a budget they cannot meet.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:cost-database
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-8
      kind: agent
      name: Project Scheduler
      templateRef: rec-04
      role: Planner building resource-loaded schedules and testing the critical path.
      prompt: You are a Project Scheduler. You build a logic-driven schedule with real durations, resource loading,
        and declared calendars, and you test the critical path for logic that is artificial rather than
        physical. You call out negative float and constraint-driven dates instead of compressing durations to
        hit a target, because a schedule that only works on paper fails on site.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:project-scheduling
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: intake
      to: role-6
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: intake
      to: role-7
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: intake
      to: role-8
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e12
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e13
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e14
      from: role-6
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e15
      from: role-7
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e16
      from: role-8
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e17
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e18
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
